title: Work tape bounds during a run
statement: Let $N$ be an oracle nondeterministic Turing machine with $k+1$ work tapes, let $O$ be a language over its symbol alphabet, and let $w$ be a Boolean word specifying the successive choices in a run from configuration $c$. Suppose that for some $n\in\mathbb N$, every work-tape head of $c$ is within distance $n$ of the origin, and every cell at distance at least $n$ from the origin is blank on every work tape. After the run, every work-tape head is within distance $n+|w|$ of the origin, and every cell at distance at least $n+|w|$ is blank on every work tape.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle nondeterministic Turing machine with $k+1$ work tapes
An oracle language over the machine's symbol alphabet
A natural number $n$ bounding every initial head's absolute position
Every initial tape cell with absolute position at least $n$ is blank
